source_acceptance_rule: Ordinary official publication/source identification and native acceptance are separate gates. Signed or wet-paper original authentication is not an added project prerequisite. Missing exact quotation versions must be resolved explicitly, without silent alias substitution.
review_scope_limits: Review is bounded by the provided retained primary sources and explicitly described web-only leads. It does not reproduce a universal archive or docket search.
Correct formal revocation does not by itself certify every earlier one-time task, suspension episode, CBA application or residual consequence.
Ongoing statutory, contractual and regulatory effects are distinguished from continuing authority under the revoked executive order.
Unknown installment performance does not by itself block the total ending of a continuing command.
